mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, status, workflow_id AS workflowId, project_id AS projectId, workflow_version_id AS workflowVersionId, queue_id AS queueId, priority FROM task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING') AND deleted = false ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS stepId, step_name AS stepName, step_type AS stepType, mutex_group AS mutexGroup FROM workflow_step WHERE workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT source_step_id AS sourceStepId, target_step_id AS targetStepId FROM workflow_edge WHERE workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId}

SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.step_id AS stepId, ts.status, ts.mutex_group AS mutexGroup, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq, ts.retry_count AS retryCount, ts.resource_request AS resourceRequest, ov.start_command AS startCommand, COALESCE(ts.max_retry_count, ws.retry_count, 0) AS maxRetryCount, COALESCE(ws.retry_interval_seconds, 5) AS retryIntervalSeconds FROM task_step ts LEFT JOIN workflow_step ws ON ws.id = ts.step_id LEFT JOIN operator_version ov ON ov.id = ws.operator_version_id WHERE ts.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ts.step_index

SELECT id, executor_node_name AS nodeName, cluster_id AS clusterId, online_status AS onlineStatus, os_type AS osType, tags, credential_ref_id AS credentialRefId, cpu_total AS cpuTotal, gpu_total AS gpuTotal, memory_total AS memoryTotal, disk_total AS diskTotal, running_task_count AS runningTaskCount, last_allocated_at AS lastAllocatedAt, max_concurrent_steps AS maxConcurrentSteps FROM executor_node WHERE enabled = true AND deleted = false AND online_status = 'ONLINE' AND credential_ref_id IS NOT NULL
